definition: Calm mental balance during difficulty or provocation.
author: Marcus Aurelius
quote: Doth he bear all adverse chances with more equanimity: or with his neighbour's offences with more meekness and gentleness than I?
example_sentence: She met the bad news with remarkable equanimity.
